AIR 100 Sattwik Satyakam Devta explains the 3-cycle approach he followed in the exam. First, secure the questions you know. Then return to the 50-50s and use elimination. Finally, take a limited number of calculated risks.

The goal is not to attempt everything. It is to build your attempts step by step while protecting your accuracy.

A simple approach to question selection that can completely change how you handle the Prelims paper.
